title: Narcissus
html_source: Narcissus, in Greek mythology, is represented as a beautiful youth, who, because he refused all love, was punished by Nemesis who caused him to fall in love with a reflected image of himself. The use of Narcissus here could point to Stephen’s refusal of Bloom’s love and concern for him, as well as to Stephen’s tendencies toward self-preoccupation.
